scope: Independent targeted mathematical, coverage, and data-semantics review of the catalogue addition; not a full re-review of the existing prerequisite corpus.
outcome: No remaining confirmed mathematical or structural blocker in the reviewed catalogue. Rendering integration is tracked separately below.
reviewed: Separate real and complex object identities; low-dimensional and symbolic parameter domains; explicit global forms of exceptional groups.
Split composition algebras, Cayley-Dickson formulas, sedenion nonassociativity and zero-divisor boundaries, and exclusion of octonionic Hermitian sizes above three from Jordan families.
Real and complex Heisenberg groups and Lie algebras; quaternionic matrix conventions; selected classical dimensions and low-dimensional isomorphisms.
Finite fields, p-adic and Laurent-series fields, adeles and ideles, rational quaternion algebras, and Hurwitz/Lipschitz orders as distinct objects.

All sixteen compact magic-square cells, machine-readable second construction inputs, Vinberg bracket correction, triality modules, and distinction between module isomorphisms and underlying vector-space isomorphisms.

All 91 root core.json morphism-space claims and all nine root morphism knowls: scalar C and Q(i), Jordan unit conventions and idempotent Hom-sets, finite-field zero-versus-empty distinctions, scalar restriction, and real versus holomorphic SL(2,C) maps.
The eight added nonunital zero-product Jordan objects and their 24 End/Aut records; finite-prime-field module views and the 14 added arithmetic morphism classifications.
Structural relationships versus categorical arrows, fixed scalar agreement on views, explicit completeness and conditions, sparse browser indexes, and indexed read-only query paths.

source_checks.title: Barton and Sudbery, Magic squares and matrix models of Lie algebras
source_checks.locator: Section 4.2, equations (4.19)-(4.21), Theorem 4.3, printed page 19; preceding paragraph on printed page 18
source_checks.checked: The Vinberg tensor product, derivation correction and coefficient ordering match the authored formula. The preceding paragraph explicitly excludes H_n(O) and split-octonion H_n from Jordan algebras for n > 3.

source_checks.title: Alberto Elduque, Composition algebras
source_checks.locator: Section 1.1, equation (3); Section 1.3, octonion doubling formula and norm/alternativity discussion
source_checks.checked: Quaternion/octonion doubling conventions, the positive division norm, and the associative-versus-alternative distinction used in the catalogue boundary checks.

resolved_findings.finding: The initial validator allowed a construction or structural relationship to carry a morphism category, and allowed an explicit view scalar to disagree with its category.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validator now requires null categories for structural kinds, a category for isomorphism/embedding/quotient/covering kinds, and agreement with a category's fixed scalar. Existing authored rows were not false morphisms.

resolved_findings.finding: Missing nonunital Jordan examples made the object distinction between Jord and UJord invisible.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added separate real and complex zero-product Jordan objects for dimensions 1, 2, 3, and n, excluding them from unital-object categories and supplying exact End/Aut descriptions.

resolved_findings.finding: Finite-field pages described prime-field linear maps without corresponding explorer views.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added F2, F3, and explicitly fixed-parameter F_p vector-space categories/views, together with small-field linear and field-map comparisons.

resolved_findings.finding: Several indefinite Lie groups lacked corresponding Lie-algebra records; the dimension-four direct-sum isomorphisms were not represented by object edges.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added the indefinite Lie-algebra families and links, plus su(2) direct sum su(2), real sl(2) direct sum real sl(2), and complex sl(2) direct sum complex sl(2), with the appropriate so(4) and so(2,2) isomorphisms.

resolved_findings.finding: Five core descriptions called general matrix endomorphism algebras a 'composition algebra', conflicting with the established quadratic-norm meaning of that term.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reworded to endomorphism/matrix algebras under composition; verified the misleading phrase was removed from core morphism descriptions.

resolved_findings.finding: The 14 arithmetic morphism records initially omitted coverage and would have defaulted to partial despite exact classifications.
resolved_findings.resolution: Arithmetic author confirmed coverage: complete was added to all 14 records. Their mathematical counts and classifications were independently checked.

rendering_integration.status_at_recording: Arithmetic author is repairing the shared delimiter formatting; final rendered verification belongs to root.
rendering_integration.classification: Rendering integration defect, not a mathematical blocker or a claim that the affected formulas were validated in the browser by this reviewer.

known_limitations: This is a substantial initial catalogue, not an exhaustive list of mathematical objects, real/global forms, category memberships, or morphisms.
SL(2,C) group-map examples and general associative-algebra map examples are deliberately partial; no unproved exhaustive classification is claimed.
Symbolic families and scalar bindings retain explicit conditions; the catalogue does not execute or universally discharge those conditions.
Relationship arrows currently use canonical object/category structures. Future arrows between noncanonical named structures will need explicit endpoint-view semantics.
Missing Hom records mean not catalogued, not empty. No automatic composition or inverse is inferred from absence or from construction relationships.
No Lean proof was supplied or verified. Evidence remains direct textual reasoning or cited literature, with Lean references unset.
The separate transcript-definition addition and exhaustive final rendering checks were outside this independent catalogue review.
